raw_text: Maldives-China military deal is a disaster for India. Coast guard facility on Marao atoll? That's a future Chinese naval base right in India's backyard. The India Out campaign worked exactly as China planned. India lost its military presence and now China is filling the vacuum. String of Pearls is becoming reality.
